Added the paper's actual sequencing endpoint: 16-cycle Phusion Flash duplicate barcoded Illumina-adapter PCR on the plasmid library, terminating in a sequencing plan carrying only the limitation 'MiSeq v3 150-cycle kit, 10% PhiX; adapter primers and barcodes not printed'. Page and note state that the Joung one-PCR library is a separately cited compatible readout, not Sanjana et al.'s own experiment.
